'''Fallon Pollo''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] active for 10 years, 2 months. Just after retiring in style, Pollo began working for the highest bidder again, unable to stop working because of the action. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Pollo was hired by the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] to hunt down [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on a team led by [[Lune Oddo Divinian|Lune Divinian]]. Pollo attacked Skywalker with the team in the atmosphere of the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], but crashed his [[Preybird-class starfighter|Preybird]] style ship in an old,and abandoned barracks. There was a wound in his leg, and while he was worrying about that, he was attacked by a creature made by [[Elo Panil]]. After being chased into an alley, Pollo was eaten by the creature.<ref name="Rebel Force: Firefight">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>
